name: JMJR ENTERPRISES OPC
notes:
JMJR ENTERPRISES OPC (JMJR FiberNet) is a regional fiber ISP based in Koronadal City, South Cotabato, Mindanao, Philippines, serving residential FTTH and business/DIA customers across South Cotabato and Sultan Kudarat.

- Open peering policy: we welcome peering with content providers, CDNs, cloud and regional networks.

- IRR as-set: AS154267:AS-ISP | RPKI ROAs published for our prefixes.

- RIPE Atlas probe 1018464; RIPE Atlas anchor ph-ges-as154267 (coming online).

- Peering requests: peering@jmjropc.com | NOC: noc@jmjropc.com
